title: Austin Leaders Discuss Nuclear Plant & Lawsuits
summary:
*   City leaders met in a private executive session to discuss confidential legal matters.
*   Key topics included ongoing litigation involving Westinghouse Electric and Houston Lighting & Power.
*   A significant discussion focused on the city's ownership interest in the South Texas Nuclear Plant.
